our_side: One seat (record-0, team 1), Armada from the south-east box (home H7, start (3764, 3287)); the player claude-opus-5-5 at effort medium, no commander seat; Jev jev-latest as the pianist on the hands rebuilt 2026-10-02 with human-11's fixes (losses with killers, staged lists, the realtime flight review); every layer; realtime (run/human_game.sh). summary: The user played a self-described silly build: constructor aircraft expanding into our half, Banshees from about 4:54, then Centurions from 8:23. A Tick crossed at 3:51 and killed his expansion extractors (the player's note at 6:03: ~6 killed, trade 105 vs 925), and we led his seen army from 5:00 on (831 vs 135; 2.9k vs ~0.8k at 12:03). From 5:08 to 13:30, though, the player's orders sent the army only at his outer spots or held it in our half, and the hands bled it there: 13 Pawns lost in ten seconds at E4 (9:22-9:32) after a shell/walk thrash with anti-air Crossbows counted as artillery, and two Centurions razed the second lab, five solars and the nano at home while 28 soldiers churned (12:34-13:25). The commit at 13:30 went as one body, stalled 30 s at his C2 heavy turret (15:23-15:56), broke it by 17:06 and razed his base at B2 with his commander and advanced lab (17:08-17:34). The economy stayed thin: 6-8 extractors from 4:00 to 14:00 and the energy store empty 17.2% of the game.

root.what: With the first lead (6.2x his seen army at 5:00, the player: 'He plays air ... with few ground soldiers'), the player's orders barred his base and later gated the push on a count. 5:08: 'never goes to spot_1 or spot_2 ... without new orders'; 5:28 the raid turned into a constructor escort; 6:03 'push his base ... when about 20 soldiers'; the bar repeated at 6:21, 7:16, 7:45 and 8:07. group_T reached 23 by 8:00 and stood at B4, 1,100-1,500 from his start, at 8:24, then turned east for four Centurions. The commit came at 13:30. The user's complaint names the symptom; this cause is the reader's reading.

bears_on.note: We led his seen army 6x from 5:00 and 2.9k vs 0.8k at 12:03, yet held until 13:30. The user's 'never actually trying to kill me ... until late' repeats thebluegecko's 'time to go fight and win'. Once committed, the lead razed his base in about 4 minutes.

The first unit across (a Tick at 3:51, 612 from his start at 4:24) paid. By the player's note it killed ~6 of his air-built extractors (105 vs 925 by 6:03). The Pawns that crossed at 4:52 came back within a minute.
group_T split 8 of 23 off to hunt Centurions (8:27) and lost 13 Pawns in pieces. The 13:30 commit as one body (21, then 34 Maces) broke C2 and razed B2.

'wandered back and forth ... and never acualy attacked': group_G1 alternated attack/shell/walk for a minute against two Centurions at home (12:34-13:25). The air was answered from its first signs with Crossbows and Nettles.
We held 6-8 extractors of 19 from 4:00 to 14:00 while his armca took spots in our half. The win came against a weak build, not through the economy.
The energy store was full (1,452-1,602) with metal at 0 from 4:00 to 8:00, then stalled at 11:00, 13:00 and 15:00. There was no energy store or converter to hold the surplus.

tools: strategist-0.jsonl orders and reports read directly
lens.caveats: The opponent is a person, so there is no truth file: his army, extractors and tier 2 are only what we saw (floors), and minutes.py's HIS TIER 2 is empty. The archive has no results.jsonl or batch.json, so analyze_match prints outcome None; the result comes from the ledger and bot.log ('enemy base ... is razed' at f=31605). pro_baseline.py was not run: Avalanche is not Comet and has no pool cards. commander_turns --told was not read in full; the instructs were extracted whole from strategist-0.jsonl. That a push from B4 at 8:24 would have won earlier is the reader's reading. The only person's words are the user's two ledger quotes; there are no chat comments. The ledger reads the army as 'held from 0:00 to 13:30'. This reader differs in part: from 6:21 to 8:34 the army did raid his half (67% of our mass there at 8:00, at B4 at 8:24), but his base (spot_1/spot_2) stayed barred until 13:30. The 8:27 split was of Centurions, and the 'never split off to hunt aircraft' clause was not in the 8:07 text then in force.

Were the hands' aircraft hunts against 'never hunt or chase an armca or armkam' ever fixed (the impedance fixes of 2026-10-16/17?), and is the attack/shell/walk churn at the bar closed?

Why was spot_11 (924 from home, second on the 0:10 constructor list) still missing at 12:03 (the player's note)? Not looked into.
Did the energy-0 minutes (11, 13, 15) stop the extractors' metal (income 9.1 with 12 extractors at 15:00), as facts/economy.md's all-or-nothing upkeep implies? Not checked second by second.
